title: Signs your brakes need attention
summary: Squeals, grinding and a pedal that feels different are all worth a call. Here is what each one can mean.
author: The Kestrel Garage team

body.p: Brakes usually give some warning before they need work. Noticing the change early often keeps the repair simpler.

body.h2: What to listen and feel for

ul: A high-pitched squeal when you brake can be the pad wear indicator.
Grinding can mean the pads are worn through.
A soft or sinking pedal needs checking straight away.
The car pulling to one side under braking is worth an inspection.

body.p: Tell the front desk what you have noticed and when it happens. If the car feels unsafe, do not drive it: arrange recovery instead.
